summary: Successfully completed comprehensive testing of Live TV functionality. All core features working perfectly including channel switching, live position synchronization, keyboard controls, and schedule display.
passed_tests: Live TV page loads successfully at /live route
Channel list displays 14 channels with proper numbering
Channel switching works via clicking channel buttons
Channel switching works via up/down arrow keyboard controls
Video player displays YouTube iframes with correct autoplay settings
Live position synchronization working (videos start at calculated live time position)
Schedule bar displays with current 'NOW' indicator and upcoming programs
Keyboard shortcuts: 'm' for mute, 'g' for channel list toggle
Control buttons functional: channel up/down, mute, fullscreen, toggle sidebar
Live indicators present with pulsing animation
Channel info overlay appears on hover with channel name and current time
Program durations displayed correctly (5 min programs)
Rapid channel switching stable without errors
Channel list can be toggled on/off
Current time display working (7:02:23 AM format)
YouTube video autoplay enabled for continuous playback
